connector.name: Mailbox by mailbox.bot
connector.registryDescription: Physical mail API for AI agents. Send letters, certified mail. Sandbox + live keys via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at mailbox.bot over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace bot.mailbox, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Use an agent key (sk_agent_...) for autonomous agents, a sandbox key (sk_agent_test_...) for zero-charge testing on production endpoints, or a member key (sk_live_...) for personal use. Mint keys at https://mailbox.bot/mcp-install.
